---
title: "K-space and image encoding"
description: "Change how k-space is sampled and see the effect on the reconstructed image."
toc: false
---

Explore the relationship between k-space sampling, spatial resolution and field of view. Compare the full acquisition with reconstructions from different sampling patterns.

- Remove the outer parts of k-space. What happens to fine spatial detail?
- Increase the spacing between sampled phase-encoding lines. Where does wraparound appear?
- Use image prescription mode to compare the requested and achievable voxel sizes.
